review_notes: I read the whole target file. It has no new definitions or structures, only lemmas: each_iso_three_hubs_general, hub_iso_sum_general, dist_le_three_of_mem_closeSet, s0_of_no_medge, deg3_eq_isoTwins_of_s0 and twin_incidence_total. The concept-like objects it uses (deg3Set, isoTwins, hubSet in DoubleStar.lean; closeSet in CompactCell.lean; cross_count in Incidence.lean) are defined in other files, so they are outside this target. deg3Set, hubSet and isoTwins are filters on `G.degree`. closeSet is an explicit radius-3 union of neighbour finsets. I did not find a competing definition of a Mathlib concept in the target. Possible overlaps with Mathlib, such as a closeSet that resembles a distance ball, or cross_count as a double-counting identity, are either not defined here or are theorem-level duplication, which the rubric excludes. dist_le_three_of_mem_closeSet is the bridge from closeSet to Mathlib's `G.dist`, so it integrates with Mathlib rather than competing with it. I found no justified finding. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for a ball API on SimpleGraph, but that would concern closeSet's own file anyway.
